title: Location
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a place from which business is conducted or technology is hosted. Locations provide spatial context for Structures (Organization Units, Nodes) and constrain deployment/operational geography. Rootless — a Location is a classification dimension, not an active system. TOGAF mapping: Location (Content Metamodel, cross-domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Content Framework).

locationType.description: Location classification. PHYSICAL = a geographic site or facility. LOGICAL = an abstract location boundary (e.g., region, zone). VIRTUAL = a cloud/virtual location. TOGAF mapping: Location type in Content Metamodel.

reach.description: Geographic reach scope. TOGAF mapping: Location scope classification.
